description: /translate-locales --dry-run is a thin wrapper of locale-translator: it reports what is due (the label snapshot is not yet imported, both pages are new for tr) and writes nothing, not even the state folder. The run itself is tc-41a. Covers the command only.
setup:
mkdir -p labels && cat > labels/tr.json <<'EOF'
{
  "menu.transactions": "İşlemler",
  "menu.settings": "Ayarlar",
  "filters.open": "Filtreler",
  "field.date": "Tarih",
  "field.currency": "Para birimi"
}
EOF
git add -A && git commit -q -m 'Case setup'

assertions.name: says the label import is due
